newsitem.title: UK: Britannia Cons bags 17 mln stg contracts.
newsitem.headline: Britannia Cons bags 17 mln stg contracts.

text.p: Britannia Construction, a division of Britannia Group Plc, said on Tuesday that it had secured new construction contracts worth 17 million stg so far in 1997.
The company said it had bagged contracts of 10 million stg in April alone.

"The level of new project awards demonstrates Britannia Construction's positive start to 1997 and, having concluded satisfactorily the negotiations foreshadowed in the preliminary results, the division is confident of a more balanced year's trading," the firm's managing director Mike Bishop said.
The firm has been awarded ten projects, three of them from British retail foods group Tesco.
